affected.note: Member IDs of the ticketing service GETTIIS. Per-item counts: hashed passwords 311,451, email addresses 311,426, names 309,759, phone numbers 309,668, encrypted partial card data (first and last 4 digits, holder name, expiry) 29,515. Full card numbers and security codes were not stored.

summary.en: Link Station found that between about midnight and 7 a.m. on 2026-10-18 an attacker exploited a vulnerability in its organizer-facing ticketing system Gettii-Lite to obtain member data of its ticket purchase service GETTIIS. It confirmed that data tied to 317,971 member IDs leaked, including names, phone numbers, email addresses and hashed passwords.
summary.ja: リンクステーションは、2026年10月18日午前0時頃から7時頃にかけて、第三者が主催者向けサービス「Gettii-Lite」のプログラムの脆弱性を悪用し、チケット購入サービス「GETTIIS」の会員情報を取得していたことを確認した。会員ID317,971件分の氏名、電話番号、メールアドレス、ハッシュ化されたパスワードなどが漏えいした。
